home.title: Funny Multi
home.subtitle: Build absurd stories together, 3 to 7 players. Phone-friendly.
home.rules: Each round, pick an answer to a playful question from the list. Your picks get mixed with everyone else's into absurd stories. Then each story becomes a cartoon and we reveal them all.
home.roomGone: That room no longer exists — it may have ended, or the link is old.
home.imagesToday: Up to {{total}} cartoons per day. Resets daily at 00:00 UTC.
home.uiLanguage: Tap to change the interface language
home.unsupportedLanguage: This room is in a language this app version cannot play yet. Try updating the page, or create a new room.
